_meta.title: VerdeScope Emission Factor Library
_meta.standard: IPCC 2006 Guidelines + 2019 Refinement | API Compendium 3rd Edition
_meta.note: All values locked to AR6. Do not override without regulatory approval and version increment.
_meta.units_convention: All emission factors yield kg of pollutant per unit of activity data

CH4.nuprc_note: Use gwp20=82.5 for Energy Intensity calculation per NUPRC Guide 0024-2022 Appendix D

gas_flaring._description: Emissions from combustion of associated gas at flare stacks

CO2_per_m3_flared.basis: Assumes 98% DRE; Carbon content of Nigerian associated gas
CO2_per_m3_flared.source: IPCC 2006 Vol 2 Ch4.2 default; NUPRC validated

CH4_unburned_fraction.unit: kg CH4 / m3 gas flared (at 98% DRE)
CH4_unburned_fraction.basis: 1 - DRE fraction of CH4 in gas composition

stationary_combustion._description: Combustion of fossil fuels in turbines, generators, heaters, and engines

natural_gas_rich._description: Rich / wet gas with higher C2+ content

stationary_combustion._turbine_note: NUPRC requires 100% replacement of single-cycle to combined-cycle by 2030 (new projects: immediate)

fugitive_equipment._reference: API Compendium 3rd Edition | NUPRC Guide 0024-2022 §3.4 | IPCC 2006 Vol 2 Ch4.3
fugitive_equipment._description: Equipment-count emission factors for fugitive methane from upstream components

pneumatic_pumps.note: 5-year phase-in to non-emitting alternatives per NUPRC Guide 0024-2022 §3.4.2

wet_seal.control_requirement: Route oil degassing to combustion device OR convert to dry seal

reciprocating_compressor_rod_packing.note: Replace at 26,000 hours OR 36 months from last replacement, whichever occurs first. New compressors: 36 months from startup.

glycol_dehydrators.note: Calculation input parameters: glycol circulation rate (L/hr), gas temperature (°C), contact pressure (kPa), BTU content (MJ/m3), contact temperature (°C)

storage_tanks._model: EPA E&P Tank (Tier 2) | API MPMS Ch19.4

flash_gas_ef_kg_voc_per_m3_throughput.basis: API MPMS Ch19.4 default Nigerian crude API 28–35

storage_tanks.note: Tanks below 2 tpy VOC: annual flash analysis required if no vapour recovery system

venting.cold_venting_status: PROHIBITED — NUPRC Guide 0024-2022 §3.3.1 in line with Flare Gas Regulation 2018
venting.waiver_regime: Operator must apply to NUPRC Chief Executive for waiver on grounds of operational exigency
venting.note: Cold venting to cold vent stack is prohibited. Remaining venting must be routed to flare unless gas is non-flammable or volume too low for stable flame.

nigeria_national_grid.source: NNPC/ECN Nigeria Energy Intensity Report 2023 estimate

scope2_electricity.market_based_note: Use supplier-specific emission factor if renewable energy certificate (REC) or Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) applies

energy_intensity.gwp_basis: IPCC AR6 20-year GWP for fossil methane — mandated by NUPRC
energy_intensity.note: Operators must demonstrate 2.5% per year reduction in energy intensity from 2020 base year. EI is calculated using GWP20 specifically for this metric only; all other CO2e reporting uses GWP100.

inspection_frequency.offshore_unmanned: At planned maintenance visits up to onshore frequency

carbon_market._reference: Nigeria Carbon Market Framework October 2025 | VCS VM0039 | ISO 14064-2

VCS_VM0039.title: Methane Capture and Combustion from Petroleum Production and Distribution
VCS_VM0039.applicability: Upstream oil and gas methane abatement including LDAR and pneumatic controller replacement

Gold_Standard_methane.title: Avoided Methane Emissions from Upstream Oil and Gas
Gold_Standard_methane.applicability: Flare elimination and methane abatement projects

PACM_Article_6_4.title: Paris Agreement Crediting Mechanism
PACM_Article_6_4.applicability: Projects authorised under Nigeria Carbon Market Framework Article 6.4

vcm_price_range_usd_per_t.source: CTX / Xpansiv methane abatement credits April 2026

carbon_market.corresponding_adjustment: Required for Article 6.2 and 6.4 credits — NCCC as DNA must authorise
